summary: Implemented Console.out in rich/console.py (placed after print; delegates to print with emoji/markup off, no_wrap on, overflow ignore, crop off; highlight defaults to True). Added tests in tests/test_console.py (test_out plus test_out_empty, _markup_emoji, _container, _no_crop, _style, _highlight_default/_none/_false, _render_hook) and added RenderHook and Text imports at the top. Added "Added Console.out" to the CHANGELOG Unreleased Added list and a "Low level output" section to docs/source/console.rst after Logging. No commits made. Tests were not run per instructions, so they are unverified; the style and highlight tests assert escape sequences that were not traced through print.
